item.text: {"search_note":"I found strong evidence on federal security, digital regulation, budget, and administrative-process implementation. I found much weaker direct evidence on SPD party discipline, regional implementation depth, and day-to-day delivery inside ordinary ministries and Länder beyond the digital-service and municipal-capacity files. The biggest limitation is timing: several good 2024 implementation items were overtaken by late-year coalition collapse and the December no-confidence vote, so durability is materially weaker than
